subject_uz: Xalq banki tizimida uy-joy qurilishida loyihaviy moliyalashtirish segmentini ishlab chiqish va eskrou hisobvaraqlari mexanizmini joriy etish bo'yicha konsalting xizmati

requirements.summary_uz: Ishtirokchi tijorat banklarida loyihaviy moliyalashtirish va eskrou bo'yicha diagnostika va tahlil xizmatlarini ko'rsatganligini shartnoma va dalolatnoma bilan tasdiqlashi kerak (2 ball, afzalroq).
requirements.summary_en: The bidder should confirm, with a contract and acceptance act, that it has provided diagnostic and analysis services to commercial banks on project finance and escrow (2 points, preferred).
requirements.quote: tijorat banklarida diagnostika va tahlil ishlari yuzasidan tegishli xizmatlarni ko‘rsatganligi

requirements.summary_uz: Jamoada O'zbekiston tijorat banklarida loyihaviy moliyalashtirish tajribasiga ega mutaxassis bo'lishi (1 ball).
requirements.summary_en: A team member with project-finance experience in Uzbekistan's commercial banks (1 point).
requirements.quote: Ishtirokchi jamoasi tarkibida O‘z. Res.tijorat banklarida loyihaviy moliyalashtirish sohasida tajribaga ega mutaxassis mavjudligi

requirements.summary_uz: Jamoada MDH davlatlarida uy-joy loyihaviy moliyalashtirish va eskrou bo'yicha vakolatli yoki ishchi organlarda tajribaga ega mutaxassis bo'lishi shart; aks holda 0 ball va tenderdan chetlatish (2 ball).
requirements.summary_en: The team must include a specialist with CIS authority or working-body experience in housing project finance and escrow; with 0 points the bidder is excluded (2 points).
requirements.quote: Ishtirokchi jamoasi tarkibida MDH davlatlarida uy joy qurilish obyektlarini loyihaviy moliyalashtirish, eskrou mexanizmlarini joriy etish bo‘yicha vakolatli yoki ishchi organlarda ish tajribasiga ega bo‘lgan mutaxassisning mavjudligi

requirements.summary_uz: Jamoada FRM, CFA, PFRM yoki CAIA sertifikatiga ega xodim bo'lishi shart; aks holda 0 ball va tenderdan chetlatish (1 ball).
requirements.summary_en: The team must include an employee holding an FRM, CFA, PFRM or CAIA certificate; with 0 points the bidder is excluded (1 point).
requirements.quote: FRM (Financial Risk Manager) yoki CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst) yoki PFRM (Professional Financial Risk Manager) yoki CAIA (Chartered Alternative Investment Analyst) sertifikatiga ega xodimning mavjudligi

requirements.summary_uz: Davlat ro'yxatidan o'tganiga olti oy to'lmagan tashkilotlar tenderda ishtirok eta olmaydi.
requirements.summary_en: Organisations registered less than six months before the announcement may not take part.
requirements.quote: tender o‘tkazish to‘g‘risidagi e’lon berilgan sanada davlat ro‘yxatidan o‘tganiga olti oy to‘lmagan

requirements.summary_uz: Oxirgi yillik (2025) moliyaviy holat va natijalar to'g'risida ma'lumot yoki soliq organi tasdiqlagan hisobot.
requirements.summary_en: Information on the latest annual (2025) financial position and results, or a tax-authority-confirmed report.
requirements.quote: Ishtirokchining oxirgi yillik (2025-yil) moliyaviy holati va natijalari to‘g‘risida ma’lumot

requirements.summary_uz: Xizmat avans to'langan kundan boshlab 10 oy yoki 305 kalendar kun ichida bajariladi.
requirements.summary_en: The service is to be delivered within 10 months or 305 calendar days of the advance payment.
requirements.quote: Oldindan to‘lov (bo‘nak) amalga oshirilgan kundan boshlab 10 oy yoki 305 kalendar kun muddatda

requirements.summary_uz: 15 foiz avans; qolgan 85 foiz to'rt bosqichda 20 foizdan, yakuniy 5 foiz ishlar to'liq qabul qilingach to'lanadi.
requirements.summary_en: 15 percent advance; the remaining 85 percent is paid in four stages of 20 percent, with a final 5 percent after full acceptance.
requirements.quote: Oldindan to‘lov (bo‘nak) shartnoma umumiy qiymatining 15 (o‘n besh) foizini tashkil etadi

requirements.summary_uz: Taklif ta'minoti boshlang'ich narxning 1 foizi (133 mln so'm).
requirements.summary_en: Bid security of 1 percent of the start price (133 million UZS).
requirements.quote: Tender taklifi ta’minoti hajmi tender boshlang‘ich qiymatining 1 foizini tashkil qiladi

requirements.summary_uz: G'olib shartnoma summasining 1 foizi miqdorida bajarish kafolatini taqdim etadi.
requirements.summary_en: The winner provides a performance guarantee of 1 percent of the contract amount.
requirements.quote: Tender g‘olibi tuzilayotgan shartnomaning umumiy summasining 1 foizi miqdorida shartnoma majburiyatlarini bajarish kafolatini

flags.quote: Ishtirokchi jamoasi tarkibida MDH davlatlarida uy joy qurilish obyektlarini loyihaviy moliyalashtirish, eskrou mexanizmlarini joriy etish bo‘yicha vakolatli yoki ishchi organlarda ish tajribasiga ega bo‘lgan mutaxassisning mavjudligi
flags.explanation_uz: Mezon 4 (2 ball, jami 7 balldan) o'tish bali 4 bo'lgan sharoitda tenderdan chetlatish bilan bog'langan: 0 ball olgan ishtirokchi chetlatiladi. Talab MDH davlatlaridagi "vakolatli yoki ishchi organlar"da ishlagan mutaxassisni nazarda tutadi, bu juda tor doira; bank bilan ishlashga qodir, lekin bunday tajribasi bo'lmagan konsalting kompaniyalari ishtirok eta olmasligi mumkin. Mavzuga aloqador sabab bo'lishi mumkin, shuning uchun tekshirish tavsiya etiladi.
flags.explanation_en: Criterion 4 (2 of 7 points, with a pass mark of 4) is tied to exclusion: a bidder scoring 0 is disqualified. The requirement is for a specialist who has worked in CIS "authorised or working bodies", a very narrow pool; capable consulting firms without such a person may be shut out. A subject-related reason is conceivable, so a person should check it.
flags.rewrite_uz: Jamoada uy-joy qurilishini loyihaviy moliyalashtirish yoki eskrou mexanizmlari sohasida (O'zbekiston yoki chet elda) kamida 3 yillik tajribaga ega mutaxassis bo'lishi; bu mezon bo'yicha 0 ball tenderdan chetlatish uchun asos bo'lmaydi.
flags.rewrite_en: The team includes a specialist with at least 3 years of experience in housing project finance or escrow mechanisms (in Uzbekistan or abroad); a 0 score on this criterion is not grounds for exclusion.

flags.quote: FRM (Financial Risk Manager) yoki CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst) yoki PFRM (Professional Financial Risk Manager) yoki CAIA (Chartered Alternative Investment Analyst) sertifikatiga ega xodimning mavjudligi
flags.explanation_uz: Mezon 5 (1 ball) to'rtta xalqaro sertifikatdan birini talab qiladi va 0 ball olish tenderdan chetlatishga olib keladi. Mezon 1, 4 va 5 chetlatish bilan bog'langan va ularning ballari yig'indisi (1+2+1=4) o'tish baliga teng, ya'ni uchala talab ham amalda majburiy. Bank konsaltingi uchun sertifikatli xodim mantiqli bo'lishi mumkin, lekin ro'yxat tor va ekvivalent malakalar (masalan, boshqa moliyaviy-xavf sertifikatlari yoki tajriba) hisobga olinmaydi.
flags.explanation_en: Criterion 5 (1 point) requires one of four named international certificates, and a score of 0 leads to exclusion. Criteria 1, 4 and 5 all carry exclusion and their points sum (1+2+1=4) to the pass mark, so all three are effectively mandatory. A certified employee may make sense for bank consulting, but the list is narrow and equivalent qualifications or experience are not accepted.
flags.rewrite_uz: Jamoada moliyaviy xavflarni boshqarish yoki investitsiya tahlili bo'yicha xalqaro sertifikat (FRM, CFA, PFRM, CAIA yoki ekvivalent) yoki kamida 3 yillik tegishli tajribaga ega xodim bo'lishi; bu mezon bo'yicha 0 ball tenderdan chetlatish uchun asos bo'lmaydi.
flags.rewrite_en: The team includes an employee with an international certificate in financial risk management or investment analysis (FRM, CFA, PFRM, CAIA or equivalent) or at least 3 years of relevant experience; a 0 score on this criterion is not grounds for exclusion.

MDH davlatlarida loyihaviy moliyalashtirish bo'yicha tajribaga ega mutaxassisning mehnat daftarchasi (rangli skaner)
FRM, CFA, PFRM yoki CAIA sertifikati nusxasi va xodimning mehnat daftarchasi

Xarid jarayonida qoidabuzarliklarga yo'l qo'ymaslik haqidagi ariza
Taklif ta'minoti (zakalat yoki bank kafolati, 1 foiz)
